test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
‘A – B’ means ‘A is B’s wife’.

‘A + B’ means ‘A is B’s brother’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is B’s father’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is B’s sister’.

Using the same meaning of the mathematical operators as given above, in ‘T × X ÷ Y + Z’ what is T of Z’s ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 –
 
 
+

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 Wife
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Father

Given: T × X ÷ Y + Z 

T × X → T is the father of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a02f67946bbe3f964aebc14c1f192e579eda76c6d68718efbf55031aee55206.png] 

X ÷ Y → X is the sister of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b5fafc7350c38e29d7fbfe87b49f9b6965d662a294c3970530758f6439cb5ad.png] 

Y + Z → Y is the brother of Z.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5ab1768697327c227c27c9d881d74e071d523ebdfc9fe7ebbd25f0a3677e59f.png] 

Here, T is the father of Z.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
